title: Ahaz Reigns in Judah

questions.question: Who succeeded Jotham as king of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:1 (ESV): "...Ahaz the son of Jotham, king of Judah, began to reign."

questions.question: What detestable practice did Ahaz follow?
options: He burned his son as an offering
questions.correctAnswer: He burned his son as an offering
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:3 (ESV): "...and even burned his son as an offering..."

questions.question: Who besieged Jerusalem during Ahaz's reign?
options: Rezon king of Syria and Pekah king of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Rezon king of Syria and Pekah king of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:5 (ESV): "Then Rezon king of Syria and Pekah... came up to wage war on Jerusalem..."

questions.question: To whom did Ahaz send messengers for help?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:7 (ESV): "So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria..."

questions.question: What did Ahaz send to the king of Assyria?
options: Silver and gold from the house of the Lord and the king's house
questions.correctAnswer: Silver and gold from the house of the Lord and the king's house
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:8 (ESV): "Ahaz also took the silver and gold... and sent a present to the king of Assyria."

questions.question: What did Tiglath-pileser do in response to Ahaz's request?
options: He marched up against Damascus and took it, killing Rezon
questions.correctAnswer: He marched up against Damascus and took it, killing Rezon
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:9 (ESV): "...The king of Assyria marched up against Damascus and took it... and killed Rezon."

questions.question: What did Ahaz see in Damascus that he copied?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:10 (ESV): "...King Ahaz saw an altar that was at Damascus..."

questions.question: Who built the new altar in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:11 (ESV): "And Uriah the priest built the altar..."

questions.question: What did Ahaz do with the bronze altar of the Lord?
options: He moved it to the north side of his new altar
questions.correctAnswer: He moved it to the north side of his new altar
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:14 (ESV): "...and put it on the north side of his altar."

questions.question: Who succeeded Ahaz?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:20 (ESV): "Ahaz slept with his fathers... and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: What did Ahaz command regarding the morning burnt offering and evening grain offering?
options: They should be burned on the great (new) altar
They should be on the bronze altar
questions.correctAnswer: They should be burned on the great (new) altar
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:15 (ESV): "...Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering..."

questions.question: What was the bronze altar reserved for?
options: For the king to inquire by
questions.correctAnswer: For the king to inquire by
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:15 (ESV): "...but the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by."

questions.question: What did Ahaz cut off from the stands?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:17 (ESV): "And King Ahaz cut off the frames of the stands..."

questions.question: What did he take down from the bronze oxen?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:17 (ESV): "And he took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it..."

questions.question: Why did Ahaz make these changes to the temple?
options: Because of the king of Assyria
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the king of Assyria
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 16:18 (ESV): "...he removed from the house of the LORD, because of the king of Assyria."

key_verse_text: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and rescue me from the hand of the king of Syria and from the hand of the king of Israel, who are attacking me.” (ESV)
